description: Run a rule set over every row it sets — a write applies it by itself. A person’s value is never touched; a tie is named. With `link`, fill that link’s empty cells by its `found_by` instead; a set link is never moved, and a row with no match or two is named. Dry run until `commit: true`.

commit.description: Write it. Omit or false for the dry run.

format.description: The format whose rows are the rules — or, with `link`, the one the link is on.

link.description: A link column found by a date (`found_by`): fill the rows where it is empty.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

rule_set.description: By name; optional when there is one.

name: apply_rules
title: Apply a rule set
